reason: The analyst's specification (pre-period controls, no post-treatment buyer_rating, HC1 SEs) gives 0.61 (SE 0.23), close to my 0.69 (SE 0.24) with a full control set. Both find a significant positive effect, and the 1% outcome trim and the missing extra controls only shift the estimate within one SE. The report should still disclose the trim and the selection-on-observables caveat.
